Package com.medgenome.servicecommon.context

Class RequestContext

java.lang.Object
com.medgenome.servicecommon.context.RequestContext
public final class RequestContext extends Object
Thread-local storage for request-scoped data. Stores user information, correlation IDs, and other request context.
